title: WorkPackage
description: TOGAF-sourced archetype — a definition of a delivery artifact specifying a set of deliverables and activities to be developed within an ADM phase or transition. A definition from an Effector (producing team/process) to a Receptor (consuming team/process for execution). Rootless, domain-scoped. TOGAF mapping: Work Package (ADM Phase E/F, Implementation and Migration Planning). Source framework: TOGAF (ADM, Implementation and Migration Planning).

scope.description: Work Package ADM scope. FULL_ADM_CYCLE = entire architecture development. SINGLE_PHASE = scoped to one ADM phase. CROSS_PHASE = spans multiple ADM phases. TOGAF mapping: Work Package scope.

deliverableType.description: Primary deliverable type produced. TOGAF mapping: Work Package deliverable classification.

estimatedEffort.description: Estimated effort as ISO 8601 duration (e.g., 'P30D' for 30 days). TOGAF mapping: Work Package effort estimation.
